title: 16S Metagenomics in a Field Setting
author: Gideon Erkenswick
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.y2pfydn
materials: Remove samples and the following reagents and let thaw, once thawed keep on ice block 10mM DNTPs 25 mMgCl 5x Go Taq Buffer Forward primer 16S-27F (10uM) Reverse primer 16S-1429R (10uM) GoTaq Hotstart Polymerase 5u/ul Make PCR cocktail for # of samples * 1.1 (10% extra). Don't forget to include 1 PCR negative control for each separate PCR Run PCR according to the following cycle conditions: Initial denaturation 95 °C for 120s 25 cycles of 95 °C for 30s, 51 °C for 30s, 72 °C for 30s Final extension 72 °C for 420s Upon completion remove, label, and store at 4 °C , or take directly to electrophoresis

Equipment Quantus Fluorometer (DNA and RNA Quantifier, Promega, E6150, https://www.promega.com/products/fluorometers-luminometers-multimode-readers/fluorometers/quantus-fluorometer/?catNum=E6150 , https://s3.amazonaws.com/pr-journal/bb7ba.pdf ) dsDNA dye Qubit Assay Tubes Your DNA sample Pulse vortex your sample and spin down. Add 200 µL of dsDNA dye into the qubit assay tube. Make sure to cover up the tube from light Transfer 1 µL of DNA sample into qubit assay tube Pulse vortex and spin down Let it sit for 00:05:00 in room temperature Covered from the light Gently vortex and spindown the sample Calibrate the Quantus Fluormeter by standard and reference testing. Follow the same process but use 1 µL ddH 2 O and Lambda DNA. Insert the qubit assay tube into the Quantus Flurometer

steps.title: Prepare 0.8‑1.0% agarose gel
steps.instruction: Using a BlueGel or MiniOne system, measure 1 g agarose and mix with 100 mL 1× TBE; microwave 1–3 min until fully dissolved, pour into a tray with a 13‑comb set, let harden 20–30 min, then place the gel in the electrophoresis chamber and add 1× TBE buffer until fully submerged.

steps.title: Load samples and ladder onto gel
steps.instruction: Spot‑check each sample with 2 µL; if the sample does not already contain loading dye, add 1 µL loading dye to 2 µL sample, mix and load into wells. Load 5 µL of a 100 kb DNA ladder. Turn on the power and run the gel until bands are visible.

steps.title: Dilute samples to 50 nM
steps.instruction: For each sample, combine 5 µL of the PCR product with the calculated volume of ddH₂O to achieve a final concentration of 50 nM; then pool 5 µL of each diluted sample into a single tube to create the sequencing library.

steps.title: Perform SPRI cleanup of library
steps.instruction: Add Agencourt AMPure XP beads (Beckman Coulter, Cat #A63880) to the pooled library at a 1:1 bead‑to‑sample volume ratio, follow the standard SPRI protocol, and resuspend the purified library in the same volume used for the cleanup.

steps.title: Barcoding PCR with 96‑barcode kit
steps.instruction: Set up a 25 µL PCR reaction containing 1 µL of the appropriate barcode primer and 2 µL of each positive PCR amplicon (no special master mix, use the same mix as previous PCRs). Run the thermocycler: 95 °C 2 min; then 18 cycles of 95 °C 30 s, 62 °C 30 s, 72 °C 45 s; finish with a final extension at 72 °C for 5 min.
